title: utdf2gmns: A Python Package for Mobility Simulation from UTDF to SUMO
description: utdf2gmns converts Synchro Universal Traffic Data Format (UTDF) files into General Modeling Network Specification (GMNS) networks and Simulation of Urban Mobility (SUMO) inputs. This release incorporates corrections and validation completed during JOSS review.
